title: Ledger record: evidence
description: An attributable observation with declared coverage (PRD §10.2, §10.5). Evidence is scoped: an empty field, a missing observation, or an incomplete scope stays explicit. Raw process output does not prove that a process's claims are true — a runner observes the exit code, while text printed by the process remains process-reported content.

data.$comment: Phase 0: payload shape is deliberately loose — properties are optional and no additionalProperties bound is set. The property names come from the PRD §10.5 evidence anatomy.

collection_method.description: How the observation was made, e.g. `runner_exit_status`, `workspace_snapshot_diff`, `report_artifact_parse`.

covered_scope.description: What the observation actually covers — never widened to imply coverage that was not measured.

completeness.description: `partial` and `unknown` are first-class answers; omitting the field is not a way to imply `complete`.
